intro: Shwasveda Rasayan combines traditional ayurvedic herbs to maintain clear, comfortable breathing and lung hygiene. Taken consistently with warm water or honey, it supports airway cleansing, helps reduce snoring and congestion, and contributes to improved oxygenation and vitality. Ideal for seasonal wellness routines; outcomes vary by individual lifestyle and consistency. This is a supportive wellness supplement, not a medical treatment.

li: Ayurvedic blend formulated to support respiratory comfort and ease breathing issues.
Helps reduce snoring and throat/nasal congestion while cleansing lungs and airways.
Promotes better sleep quality, oxygen flow, and overall energy with regular use.
Vegetarian powder easy to mix with warm water or honey.
100 g jar for daily routine support through seasonal changes.
Mix 1–2 teaspoons (3–6 g) with warm water or honey, 1–2 times daily after meals.
Maintain hydration, steam inhalation as needed, and a balanced diet for best results.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or on medication.
